rationale: The primary limiter was narrow, unvalidated differentiation and confidential-contract procurement friction in a price-anchored direct register market. Version 4 removes the replacement-register sale and central multi-client data custody, instead licensing a client-tenant integration engine to compliance outsourcers, with revenue tied to a partner licence and repeated authorised tenant activation. This materially changes the customer, payer, offer, distribution, compounding mechanism, control point and structured economics. No partner commitment, access right, conversion, price, margin, time saving or validation result is claimed.
